capture.content_gates: OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES=1 (inline body, truncated at CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_CONTENT_MAX_LENGTH) for the inline events; OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES=file:<dir> (body written to disk, event carries body_ref) for the body_ref event
capture.note: api_request_body / api_response_body are emitted only under OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES; there is no length-only shape (the events are simply absent when the gate is off). The request body is the full Messages API request (the conversation/prompts); the response body is the model output. body is captured raw and body_ref is a pointer, both echoed verbatim (epic #87 / #94), never re-redacted at ingest. Bodies here are synthetic and truncated. See the -otlp fixture for the wire form and the prompt.id/message.uuid correlation ids retained under provider_extensions.correlation (#106).

observations.name: raw_api_bodies
observations.evidence: api_request_body/api_response_body carry body (inline) or body_ref (file mode) plus body_length, body_truncated, and model; each maps to a canonical.Event whose provider_extensions.event echoes those fields verbatim. api_request_body marks prompt_content available, api_response_body marks response_content available.
